sources.title: Max Wertheimer, Laws of Organization in Perceptual Forms (1923), English translation, university mirror

principles.sourceSummary: Contrast, size and type treatment affect text readability.
principles.application: Inspect mandatory text at intended display size with surrounding imagery.
principles.syntheticExample: The brand font is legible in the actual placement, despite modest anti-aliasing differences.
principles.counterexample: Pass a tiny unreadable disclaimer because the headline looks attractive.
principles.limits: WCAG informs web accessibility; it is not universal ad certification or a vision evaluator.

principles.sourceSummary: Spatial grouping and reading order affect perceived relationships.
principles.application: Compare actual reading order to prescribed art and concept; separate artifact deviation from upstream design error.
principles.syntheticExample: Weak hierarchy prescribed in art routes to Art director.
principles.counterexample: Send every weak score to Graphic designer without examining the art specification.
principles.limits: Natural-language causal judgments are reviewer attestations requiring qualified validation.

principles.sourceSummary: Coherent visual treatment can support consistent communication.
principles.application: Enforce explicit identity rules, while letting exploration change permitted setting and expression.
principles.syntheticExample: New scene preserves official logo/product and communicates the same strategy.
principles.counterexample: Fail exploration solely because its mood differs from old ads.
principles.limits: No measured brand-recognition or campaign-effectiveness claim is established.

principles.sourceSummary: The scoring policy is authored for this product, informed by design practice.
principles.application: Use observable communication, recognition, fit, craft and audience reasons.
principles.syntheticExample: 75 with all applicable critical checks passed meets the initial policy boundary.
principles.counterexample: 95 overrides a false product claim or changed qualifier.
principles.limits: Weights/threshold/confidence floor are uncalibrated, not empirical guarantees.

principles.sourceSummary: The one-cycle limit is a user-authorized workflow policy.
principles.application: Consolidate all findings and dependent stages into one cycle, then deliver or stop honestly.
principles.syntheticExample: Final failed image arrives flagged with unresolved issues and intended-choice rationale.
principles.counterexample: Reopen a second cycle under a new art/package version.
principles.limits: No orchestration or absent evaluator is fabricated; producer persistence is required.

required: Representative real brand/placement review by qualified design and marketing reviewers
OCR plus actual-size visual text verification
Routing cause agreement and unaffected-work preservation
Calibration of weights, threshold and confidence floor
False-positive checks on exploration and inferred style preferences
evaluation.limits: Synthetic examples are authored critique cases, not prior campaign successes or human years of experience.
